Andrew Michael has played grade cricket for Toombul and for
Sandgate-Redcliffe.  He represented Queensland Secondary Schools 15s in
2001-02; Secondary Schoolboys in 2001-02 and 2002-03; Queensland Under 17 in
2002-03.  He plays soccer.  Schools: St Patricks College, Shorncliffe;
Nudgee College. (Warwick Torrens, December 2002)
